gaps.sentence: Hardly ___ anyone noticed the subtle change in the final scene.
At no point ___ the passengers instructed to stay seated.
gaps.explanation: 'At no point were the passengers instructed …' — inverted passive.

gaps.sentence: ___ you stands the man responsible for the discovery.
gaps.explanation: Dramatic inversion: 'Before you stands the man…' — the phrase of place is fronted and the verb precedes the subject.

gaps.sentence: Should you ___ any problems, call reception immediately.
gaps.explanation: Should you experience… = If you experience… — formal conditional inversion.

gaps.sentence: Only when the last vote had been counted ___ the returning officer speak.
gaps.explanation: 'Only when' at the front forces question order: did the returning officer speak.

gaps.sentence: Only when the results were published ___ the scale of the error become clear.
gaps.explanation: 'Only when … did the scale … become clear' — inverted past simple.

gaps.sentence: Barely ___ the ink dried when the complaints began to arrive.
gaps.explanation: 'Barely had the ink dried when …' — inverted past perfect.

gaps.sentence: Only by chance ___ the letters discovered decades later.
gaps.explanation: 'Only by chance were the letters discovered' — inverted passive.
